description: Expired promotions no longer displayed; local offline slider; safer auto-update
changes: Promotions are validated against their own FromDate/ToDate window, not just the API IsPromoValid flag
Promo quantity tier and member bulk tier suppressed when the promotion is not currently running
Fixed member bulk row selector (.price-value:nth-of-type(2) never matched, so the row could never be hidden)
Promo validity dates now cleared between scans instead of persisting onto the next item
Auto-update only applies strictly NEWER versions - no more downgrading a locally patched kiosk
Removed the always-true file-size comparison that re-pulled the GitHub copy on every check
Slider images load from the local images/slider/ folder so the display works with no internet
